log.stdout:
NAME
    floati log - read mail or replay orchestration evidence

SYNOPSIS
    floati log --root ROOT [--replay [--speed X] [--plain]]

DESCRIPTION
    Read canonical ledgers. Replay renders receipt-derived orchestration events in deterministic order.

OPTIONS AND ARGUMENTS
    --root ROOT   Explicit fleet root.
    --replay      Render claims, turns, degradations, denials, and completions.
    --speed X     Interactive playback speed from 0.1 through 100; default 1.
    --plain       Emit one faithful append-only timeline without sleeping.

EXIT STATUS
    0 success; 20 refusal; 31 intentional silence; 32 no result;
    33 malformed evidence; 34 orchestration deadline; 35 degraded.
    The artifact process status is authoritative.

EXAMPLES
    floati log --root /var/tmp/fleet
    floati log --root /var/tmp/fleet --replay --speed 4
    floati log --root /var/tmp/fleet --replay --plain

orchestrate.stdout:
NAME
    floati orchestrate - seed and run a worker fleet

SYNOPSIS
    floati orchestrate --root ROOT --plan PLAN --adapter codex --deadline SECONDS [--no-animation]

DESCRIPTION
    Seed a bounded work DAG, launch at least three workers, stream the receipt-derived board, and emit one final artifact.

OPTIONS AND ARGUMENTS
    --root ROOT       Explicit prepared fleet root with registrations and authority.
    --plan PLAN       Absolute version-zero orchestration plan path.
    --adapter codex   Exact governed live-worker adapter.
    --deadline SECONDS  Overall deadline from 0.1 through 3600.
    --no-animation    Stream distinguishable plain text frames.

EXIT STATUS
    0 success; 20 refusal; 31 intentional silence; 32 no result;
    33 malformed evidence; 34 orchestration deadline; 35 degraded.
    The artifact process status is authoritative.

EXAMPLES
    floati orchestrate --root /var/tmp/fleet --plan /var/tmp/plan.json --adapter codex --deadline 120

NAME
    floati sequencer serve - run the local managed writer

SYNOPSIS
    floati sequencer serve --root ROOT --as ID [--takeover]

DESCRIPTION

OPTIONS AND ARGUMENTS
    --root ROOT   Explicit direct-home fleet root.
    --as ID       Bounded sequencer identity.
